parts.title: The Grey Platform: Earn It, Wear It, Play It (Legendary Looks) | TheOneApp
parts.description:
At TheOneApp Station, every pupil has a character of their very own. But one character steps off the train all grey, and the Gift Shop
is dark. (Psst: every new pupil gets 100 free credits for finishing the tour.)

Here, style is not given. It is earned. Finish a quiz (which one will a magnet attract?), and the credits start to add up, day by day.
Earned, never bought. Then visit the Gift Shop, and save up for the legendary looks: the Winter Wonderland Pack (Legendary, 300 credits,
only this season) and the Space Explorer Pack (Mythical, 500 credits), rocket pack and all. Try things on in the Dressing Room mirror,
and keep what you earn. Your character comes with you into every game: Boss Clash as My Hero, and the Science Claw in Versus against
your own pet buddy.

What you learn, you keep. What you earn, you wear.

The only app you need to learn Science: TheOneApp
theoneapp.sg

Featuring Pip, Momo and Basil, the pet buddies, with Heart as narrator.

Cause: lib.js n2() rounded scale() to 0.01, so slow zooms stepped; it now rounds to 4 decimals. One fix only: the same frames otherwise, the same sound (out/mix.wav), the same finish (glow, -16 LUFS), the same title, description, tags and thumbnail (thumb_v3.jpg). Replaces v3 (df3FppAf_EE).
